_comment: The first hour (Expansion 6 D.4, game/story/opening.py): what the start town's people do as a new hero walks in. opening_gate: the bell, the gate barred behind you, a crowd, one of them speaks; opening_summons: a runner with a sealed letter from the threat's own town.

opening_gate.about: As you come in, the bell goes and the gate is barred behind you; the town's people gather in the street round one who speaks for them, and the opening's beat follows.

bar: Shut it! Nobody else in or out!
Get that gate shut, damn you!
murmur: My sister's lad went that way this morning.
Where's the watch? Where's the lord?
I told you. I told you all.
tell: Hush now. Hush. We have to think.
It's no use shouting. Shouting won't help.
We knew this was coming. We all knew.
Stay inside tonight, all of you.
ask: You. You've come from outside. Will you hear us?
Stranger - a word, if you've a moment for frightened people.
You've the look of someone who can use that. Please.
Don't go yet. You'll want to hear this.
We need somebody. You'll do, if you'll do it.

opening_summons.about: A child or a serving hand runs up to you as you come in and presses a sealed letter into your hand from the town that needs you; its page opens, then the opening's beat.

call: Wait! There's a letter for you!
breath: A rider left it at the inn. Said give it to whoever came armed.
It came this morning. Nobody else would take it.
They said you'd be on the road from the west. I watched all day.
It's got a seal on. A proper one.
I'm to wait while you read it, they said.
plea: It's from {town}. That's all I know.
The rider looked half dead. Read it, go on.
I didn't open it. I swear.
Is it bad? It's bad, isn't it.
They paid me a penny to give it you. Read it.
letter:
To any who can bear arms, and will,

{hook}

We are sending this by every road. If it finds you, come {where} to {town}, and come soon.

There will be bread and a bed, and what coin we can find.

Whoever reads this,

We have no right to ask it of you, and we ask it anyway. {hook}

The lord's men will not come. Our own have tried.

Come to {town}.

To the bearer of a sword,

{hook}

This is the third letter we have sent. Perhaps this time someone will come.

Ask for us in {town}. Anyone will tell you where.

Friend,

Forgive a stranger's hand. {hook}

We are plain people and frightened. We will pay what we have.

Come {where}, to {town}. Do not wait long.

To you, whoever you are,

{hook}

They say a letter with a seal on it is always answered. We have put the best seal we have on this one.

{town} waits for you.
